# LSTM hybrid

**Rank 15 of 22** by test score · Hybrid multi-task · runs on the STM32H573 · [← all models](../../README.md#all-models)

| Test score | CV macro F1 | Fault detection | False alarms | Class accuracy | Inference (STM32H573) | Flash | RAM | MACC | Training time |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|

<sub>Test score = balanced accuracy of fault vs. no-fault on 7 unseen test recordings (mean of fault detection rate and 1 − false alarm rate).</sub>

### At a glance

<picture><source media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" srcset="../../assets/viz/model_cards/22-dark.svg"><img src="../../assets/viz/model_cards/22-light.svg" alt="LSTM hybrid: scores on unseen recordings and footprint on the STM32" width="100%"></picture>

> Highest fault detection (99.3%) but 24.5% false alarms; fills 95% of the board's SRAM.
